verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules (such as triggers or rule-based actions) are a fair question for a database, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of user-defined rules that fire actions on events. The only related item is changefeeds (CDC), which deliver change messages with ordering guarantees. That is an adjacent building block a developer would need to consume and act on, not a rule-to-action capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: CockroachDB changefeeds have an at-least-once delivery guarantee as well as message ordering guarantees.
